headline: Drought hits European agriculture, and costs rise. Romania provides €11 million in state aid for pig farmers
summary: European agricultural markets face pressure from drought and rising input costs, with cereal harvests below previous years. Romania is providing €11 million in state aid for pig farmers.
why: Drought and fertilizer costs affect crop supply and food prices across Europe, and state aid influences producer margins in livestock sectors.

original_headline: Seceta lovește agricultura europeană, iar costurile cresc. România, ajutor de stat de 11 milioane euro pentru crescătorii de porci
